verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a first-party Connector SDK for building custom connectors in Python and deploying them as an extension of Fivetran, directly matching the 'supported framework, not a fork' requirement (fivetran-docs-2, fivetran-docs-17). No independent/hands-on evidence specifically validates the SDK's ease-of-use or long-tail API coverage, and no low-code builder option is documented. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the Connector SDK experience, and evidence of a low-code builder alternative.
